1275|ed056522.name: Kyra Boucher
1275|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1285|ed056522.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1285|fe52f4ea.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1286|fe52f4ea.name: Edna Mullby
1286|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1333|877c4b1d.name: Gerik Koen
1333|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1340|e3153a3c.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|e3153a3c.text: Hello, $N.  Welcome to Thelsamar, and while you're here don't forget to visit our local brewery!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3607|c2467ddc.name: Androl Oakhand
3607|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

4200|c2e88775.name: Laird
4200|c2e88775.text: Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.

4262|21ab523d.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|21ab523d.text: Here in Darnassus you will find skilled trainers who have perfected the skills of their chosen class through ages of training and dedication.  I will guide you to one who can become your mentor, you have but to name your chosen path.

4262|ce424d00.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

5145|8fca8484.name: Juli Stormkettle
5145|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5513|451d1c98.name: Gelman Stonehand
5513|451d1c98.text: I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

5595|3804779b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

5595|bb6f725c.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|bb6f725c.text: Well ye'd be sure to find some training in the magical arts over in the Hall of Mysteries, north of the gates of Ironforge.  Juli Stormkettle can always be found there with her nose in a book.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

6737|41276936.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6738|41276936.name: Innkeeper Kimlya
6738|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

122-complete.name: Verner Osgood
122-complete.text: Thanks!  These will get me out of debt to Argus...
122-complete.title: Underbelly Scales

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

144-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-complete.text:
I do say, this is not good at all.  I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire.  What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people?  Bah, I should not ponder aloud.

Here, messenger.  Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township.  I might call upon you again.
144-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

145-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
145-accept.text: I require your assistance once again.  I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense.  It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly.  You must exercise extreme caution.  Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood.  Do not stray from the roads.
145-accept.title: Messenger to Darkshire

2038-complete.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2038-complete.text: You've done the movement a great service, $N. The troggs and leper gnomes infesting Gnomeregan will soon feel the brunt of a gnomish air assault!
2038-complete.title: Bingles' Missing Supplies

258-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
258-accept.text:
Igorath, is it? I can tell you're bursting with pride over completing the first test, hm? As I told you before, it's no large feat.

You should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them. I'll give you just twelve minutes this time.

Don't feel bad if you fail. I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!

Have I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? No? It was two years ago...
258-accept.title: A Hunter's Challenge

258-complete.name: Daryl the Youngling
258-complete.text:
You seem a bit worse for wear. No doubt the boars gave you some trouble, hm? No worries, I will be discreet about your struggle, I can imagine how hard it must be for you without the accusations of wagging tongues.

Oh! You managed to kill the boars? I... well, that is... that is to say, I'm not surprised! Any child could have--bet?

What bet?
258-complete.title: A Hunter's Challenge

309-accept.name: Miran
309-accept.text:
Ready to go, $N?

First, we need to get this powder to Ironband. It'll be a lot for me to carry, and these parts can get dangerous -- and who knows what else the Dark Irons might have in store for me.

I'll feel a lot better with you coming along.
309-accept.title: Protecting the Shipment

309-complete.name: Prospector Ironband
309-complete.text:
Oh, thank the Light the powder is here. But it is troubling news that you bring as well. To think that the Dark Irons have sympathizers able to procure this sort of material for their dastardly plans.

That's a matter for someone else to consider, some other time. I must put this powder to good use.
309-complete.title: Protecting the Shipment

385-complete.name: Marek Ironheart
385-complete.text: Well now, these are excellent specimens you collected, $N. Good money for high quality materials, that's for sure.
385-complete.title: Crocolisk Hunting

385-progress.name: Marek Ironheart
385-progress.text: Did I tell you about the time I almost lost my hand to one of the crocs? Nasty bugger it was, teeth like knives. But I was lucky... Jammed the brute's jaw shut with my knife. Still have the knife around here somewhere...
385-progress.title: Crocolisk Hunting

454-accept.name: Huldar
454-accept.text:
We'd been hauling the barrels of powder back and forth in trips before this... business. Now we have to split up the work, Miran's taking the barrels and I'm watching over the other ones.

I don't feel safe letting Miran haul the rest of the shipment by himself. When he's ready to go, maybe you could escort him on his next trip?
454-accept.title: After the Ambush

454-complete.name: Miran
454-complete.text:
Hello, $c.

You'll be escorting me to the excavation site? That's good to hear... After Saean and his cronies, who knows what else the Dark Irons might have up their sleeves?

Anyways, let me just make some final checks. Talk to me again when you're ready to go.
454-complete.title: After the Ambush

467-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
467-accept.text:
Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should!  And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!

He heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him.  If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh and see what he wants.
467-accept.title: Stonegear's Search

5-accept.name: Jitters
5-accept.text:
I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds!  I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.

Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.

I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
5-accept.title: Jitters' Growling Gut

5-complete.name: Chef Grual
5-complete.text: You need some Crab Cakes, do you?  Well I might be able to cook some up for you...
5-complete.title: Jitters' Growling Gut

56-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
56-accept.text:
As Commander of The Night Watch it is my sworn duty to protect the citizens of Darkshire.  Stormwind has retracted their commissioned guards from their posts here, leaving us to our own devices.

If you feel worthy of the task, we need your help! Assist The Night Watch by venturing forth into Tranquil Gardens, just south of Darkshire, and slaying 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.  The undead threat must be thwarted!
56-accept.title: The Night Watch

90-accept.name: Chef Grual
90-accept.text: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite!  Sure, I can make you some.  But first I'll need the supplies.  Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks. Given the many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem.  Fortunately for you, I just received my recent shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs, so all I need are the flanks to get started.
90-accept.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

93-accept.name: Chef Grual
93-accept.text:
I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs!  I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks!  Bring me Gooey Spider Legs and I'll whip you up a few of them.

I hear Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.
93-accept.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

958-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-accept.text:
$C. A task I would ask of you.

Have you seen the ruins of Ameth'Aran? If not, you will find them on the eastern side of the main road, some ways to the south. Once they were the home of many powerful Highborne, now they are a testament to the destruction their dabblings produced.

I have been told by the Sentinels that the spirits of the Highborne persist, and that they wield their ancient magical implements. Those relics must be appropriated, so that we might destroy them.
958-accept.title: Tools of the Highborne

967-complete.name: Delgren the Purifier
967-complete.text:
If you don't mind my saying, you seem a bit well-equipped for a messenger, hm? I suppose Balthule wanted to be certain that his letter reached my hands. Let's see what he has to say...

This is disturbing news. When undead or demonic forces are found, I help the Sentinels destroy them.

At first I was unaccustomed to the manners of the night elves, but I have grown to respect them greatly as allies.
967-complete.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

967-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
967-progress.text: You have some business with me, $c?
967-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

970-accept.name: Delgren the Purifier
970-accept.text:
Balthule's letter is dire. This Cult of the Dark Strand is a thorn in my side that must be removed. I have been dealing with some of the Dark Strand scum northeast of here at Ordil'Aran. One of their number possesses a soul gem that I believe holds the secret to the cult's power.

Bring it to me, and I will be able to decipher the secrets held within.
970-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

970-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
970-progress.text: Have you acquired that soul gem?
970-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

97926-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-progress.text: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?
97926-progress.title: Making Do
